mainText: Good morning. Futures are rebounding after Friday's sharp selloff, which saw the S and P down nearly two percent and the Nasdaq down nearly three percent. Dow futures are up half a percent, the S and P up half a percent, and Nasdaq one hundred futures up about eight tenths of a percent, helped by cooling oil prices and stabilization ahead of Apple earnings after the close. The ten year Treasury yield is near four point nine two percent, close to a seven week low. In premarket movers, Inovio is up two hundred sixty percent after F D A approval of its DNA immunotherapy. Perion is up thirty one percent on a four hundred twenty million dollar buyout offer. EchoStar up seven percent on a report SpaceX may buy Boost Mobile. IDEXX Labs up eight percent on strong earnings. On the downside, Check Point down six percent and Lumentum down five percent after earnings. Intel is roughly flat after plunging twenty nine percent Friday, its worst day since the nineteen eighties.
